messages:
ria: Quick sync on warmup for mixed safetensors + gz shards. Large models with many tiny shards are thrashing IO and leaving GPUs idle. Need a coordination scheme for backpressure + prioritized hydration.

matt: Hit this in staging. Too many concurrent prefetches = IO queue blows. Suggest inflight caps.

li: Edge vs S3 differences matter. Can we add priority hints to the manifest so loaders know first-n shards are "hot"?

ria: Proposal: manifest fields priority_hint (int), compress ("gz"/"none"), estimated_uncompressed_bytes. Lower priority_hint = hydrate earlier. Also add hotstart_strategy and prefetch_budget_bytes.

sam: We need clear abort semantics if OOM during warmup. Abort low-priority prefetches and keep high-priority ones.

nina: Streaming-decompress for gzipped shards would reduce peak memory. Need cancelable decompressor.

warmup-bot: Reminder: warmup.fetch_attempts metric exists. No cancellation metric today.

ria: Plan: 1) schema bump for manifest, 2) loader implements inflight slots (global per-host + per-request cap), 3) decompressor cancellation API, 4) metrics cancelled_prefetches + prefetch_latency_by_priority.

matt: Also want fallback_model_tag in manifest so routing can switch to smaller compatible variant if high-priority shards fail within X ms.

li: Dedicated customers need per-deployment overrides for prefetch_budget and inflight slots. Hosted defaults sensible.

sam: Tests: unit for throttling, integration simulating S3 tail latency and eviction during warmup, perf harness to check GPU idle reduction.

nina: Security: add checksum & signature in manifest; verify before streaming to decompressor. Loader must ignore unknown fields for compatibility.

ria: I'll open a draft RFC with the manifest diff and operator knobs. POC plan: loader + fake gz stream in a week. Keep default behavior unless hints present.

matt: I'll help implement prefetch-slot logic.

li: Ping me on the PR for Dedicated defaults and security checks.

warmup-bot: Note: warmup-queue-alert rule will be updated if cancelled_prefetches metric is added.

sam: Great, hydration hints naming approved. :thumbsup:
